Korolivka Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Ternopil Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Korolivka was the birthplace of Jacob Frank (1726–1791), founder of the Frankist movement — the heterodox messianic movement whose influence has been referenced at several other towns documented throughout this collection. The town's Jewish community, present from the late 17th century, peaked at 1,596 people (44.5 percent of the town) in 1900. On September 26, 1942, 700 to 900 Jews were sent to the Borschiv ghetto and then deported to the Bełżec death camp; most of the remaining community followed a month later.
